question: If a + b + c = 1, ab + bc + ca = -22 and abc = -40, then what is the value of (a³ + b³ + c³) + 5?
solution:
Given:

a + b + c = 1,

ab + bc + ca = –22

abc = –40

Formula used:

x3 + y3 + z3 - 3xyz = (x + y + z)[(x + y + z)2 - 3(xy + yz + xz)]

Calculation:

Putting the values in the formula we get

a3 + b3 + c3 - 3 × - (40) = 1 × {(1)2 - 3 × - (22)}

⇒ a3 + b3 + c3 + 120 = {1 + 66}

⇒ a3 + b3 + c3 + 120 = 67

⇒ a3 + b3 + c3 = 67 - 120

⇒ a3 + b3 + c3 = - 53

Now,

a3 + b3 + c3 + 5 = - 53 + 5

⇒ - 48

**∴ The value of (a3 + b3 + c3) + 5 is - 48.**
